description.en: Foundational vocabulary for essential daily needs, basic expressions, personal info, and core surroundings.
description.fr: Vocabulaire de base pour les besoins quotidiens essentiels, expressions simples et environnement immédiat.
description.ru: Базовый словарный запас для основных повседневных потребностей, простых выражений и обихода.
description.el: Βασικό λεξιλόγιο για καθημερινές ανάγκες, απλές εκφράσεις και άμεσο περιβάλλον.
description.it: Vocabolario fondamentale per le esigenze quotidiane essenziali, espressioni di base e ambiente circostante.

description.en: Practical everyday vocabulary for routines, travel, shopping, hobbies, weather, and simple opinions.
description.fr: Vocabulaire pratique pour les routines, les voyages, les achats, les loisirs et les opinions simples.
description.ru: Практический словарный запас для повседневных дел, путешествий, покупок, хобби и простых мнений.
description.el: Πρακτικό λεξιλόγιο για ρουτίνες, ταξίδια, αγορές, χόμπι και απλές γνώμες.
description.it: Vocabolario pratico per routine, viaggi, acquisti, hobby e opinioni semplici.

description.en: Expanded vocabulary for detailed conversations, workplace context, society, environment, feelings, and media.
description.fr: Vocabulaire élargi pour des conversations détaillées, le travail, la société et les médias.

description.it: Vocabolario ampliato per conversazioni dettagliate, lavoro, società e media.

description.en: Advanced vocabulary covering complex academic topics, business, politics, science, abstract ideas, and idioms.
description.fr: Vocabulaire avancé couvrant des sujets académiques, affaires, politique, science et idiomes.

description.it: Vocabolario avanzato per argomenti accademici, affari, politica, scienza ed espressioni idiomatiche.

description.en: Sophisticated vocabulary for fluent academic, legal, financial, literary, rhetoric, and technical expression.
